items.title: Lillian Hardin Armstrong Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Was he with Henderson in New York then? [INTERVIEWEE] No! He's here in Chicago.

ctx.x: I got $120 for making the records. I remember I was at $112 something like that. Anyway, when I got the money for making the records I gave half to Louis and I kept half.
Was he with Henderson in New York then?
No! He's here in Chicago. Oh, no, no.
